# Computer Known

> > Plain-English tech guides and tutorials for troubleshooting computers, BIOS/UEFI systems, and everyday technology problems.

Computer Known provides beginner-friendly, accessible technical documentation and how-to guides that break down complex computer concepts into understandable language. The site focuses on practical tech support and troubleshooting advice for users of all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- BIOS
- UEFI
- Tech Troubleshooting
- Beginner-Friendly Guides
- Computer Help
- Plain-English Explanations
- How-To Tutorials
- Tech Support
- Computer Systems
- Hardware Configuration
